text:
carmen: Heads-up — EU-west2 GPU pool showing heavy micro-shelf fragmentation, >80% of small slots are unusable for tiny-gang requests. Seeing a cascade of tiny-pod evictions on staging canaries. https://grafana.redwood/gpu/fragments?shelf=eu-west2
lee: ugh. is this the same shelf islands pattern we saw last month? any recent scaling events or rack drains?
sanjay: Not a full drain. We had a rolling kernel patch on a subset of racks at 03:10 UTC that forced a bunch of latebinds. Could be the warm pool churn + fractional gang requests.
emma: Logs show repeated backfills failing with "no suitable nodes" then scheduler tries lower-gpu-count variants and those also get evicted. snippet: ```kubectl get pods -n ml -o wide | grep tiny-canary```
ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-1184 - eu-west2 micro-shelf fragmentation, priority P2
carmen: Proposed mitigation: proactive compaction/evict of tiny orphan pods from warm nodes, then opportunistic warm-pool fill. Also consider a temporary taint + toleration flip for tiny-gangs to force packing. Thoughts?
lee: +1 for compaction. Can we do a selective drain script that only targets nodes with < 2 free contiguous slots to avoid evicting large jobs?
sanjay: I have a quick helper: ```python
# select nodes with small contiguous free ranges
# NOTE: run as dry-run first
``` Will post gist. Also we should pause autoscaler for the region during compaction.
emma: Can we avoid global rollback? Suggest schedule: 10m dry-run, 30m compaction window, re-enable autoscaler with provisioning limit increased by 1 big instance as buffer.
carmen: Action items: @sanjay - post compaction script and run dry-run; @lee - prepare kubectl drain commands and keep eviction-grace 60s; @emma - open autoscaler hold and bump reservation.
sanjay: posted gist: https://gist.github.com/sanjay/cc7f3b - dry-run flag included. Will run dry-run in staging at 12:15 UTC.
lee: drain plan (snippet): ```bash
kubectl cordon node-xyz
kubectl drain node-xyz --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --pod-selector='!app==large-gang' --grace-period=60
```
emma: I've set autoscaler hold for eu-west2 for 45 minutes and added a temporary reserved spot of 1xA10 to the pool for buffer.
carmen: Monitoring: watch the "shelf_coalescer" panel + eviction_rate and canary success. If evictions drop <5/min resume normal scheduling.
ops-bot: metric alert muted: gpu-frag-eu-west2 for 60m (muted by emma)
sanjay: dry-run complete in staging — output looks promising, coalescer would defragment ~18 nodes without large evictions. Requesting permission to run in prod at 12:40 UTC.
lee: approved, be ready to abort if pod-restores spike. I'll have a rollback playbook open.
carmen: go ahead. post the run-id when started.
sanjay: starting compaction run-id rc-2026-07 at 12:40 UTC now.```
